raw_segments.text: All I know of it, and indeed I only know so much, through piecing it out for myself.
For my father always avoids it, and even when Miss Havisham invited me to go there, told
me no more of it than it was absolutely requisite I should understand.
But I have forgotten one thing.
It has been supposed that the man to whom she gave her misplaced confidence acted throughout
